notes.title: Lazr Dev Vlog Update #24
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

This week was super busy, and I've made two videos that cover it all:

[previewyoutube=VwqQIU9u-Og;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=AkIC_iq4ITY;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a summarized list of what's been updated:

 smoke was improved visually, and can be pushed around now.
 smoke emitter was created.
 clouds were fixed and are back in the game now.
 while in fluid, smoke rises slower and ignores wind.
 cluster levels 1 and 2 now have smoke emitting from pipes.
 there is now a fps counter on screen, in addition to frametime.
 particle system was refactored to be single threaded, due to
 cache size limitations of psvita. psys was optimized as well.
 lasers no longer produce debris.
 a button pops on dialog screen upon input.
 options menu screen was completed (for now).
 frames per second counter was added, along with game timer.
 cluster district art was updated.
 mission select screen was completed.
 title was redesigned and linked to mission select screen.
 mission select screen links to cluster, bionic menagerie,
 and war foundry districts, which load appropriate levels.
 alpha city district created, title swapped to it.
 mission review screen was added, zooms out of district screen
 to reveal it, zooms back in too. part 1 and 2 produced.


So I've got an internal Alpha that I'm testing on different platforms, and getting prepared for players to test later, as a Beta. It's taken me a lot longer than I planned to get to this stage, so development is behind schedule a bit, but considering all that's happened (pandemic, category 5 hurricane), overall development is in a great spot. It took me a bit longer this week to make these videos, sorry for a Monday post! Hope you have a great week.

//MrGrak
